groups.title: Add UserService.searchUsers
groups.why: searchUsers() is the new method; it takes the new UserSearchOptions type and calls the new normalizeQuery() helper (imported in the top hunk). The tests cover both the method and the helper.

groups.title: Replace stray console.log calls with the scoped logger
groups.why: logger.ts now routes each level to the matching console method and drops the empty meta argument; call sites in the HTTP client, user cache and app bootstrap switch from console.log to createLogger(), and a leftover debug log in getUser is removed.

groups.title: Mechanical changes
groups.why: vitest 1.5.0 -> 1.6.0 bump (package.json range plus lockfile churn) and the regenerated routes file (@generated header). Nothing to review line by line.

notes: src/users/userService.ts is split three ways: #0 and #2 are search, #1 (removing console.log in getUser) is logging. A file-level grouping cannot get this right.
src/users/userService.ts#1 only deletes a line and references nothing new; structural signals can't place it, only semantic similarity to the other console.log hunks can.
src/generated/routes.ts#0 is semantically part of search (it adds the /users/search route), but by design generated files go to the mechanical group.
package.json#0 is not a lockfile, but it is the dependency half of the lockfile change, so it belongs to mechanical.
